fineRelief.name: ArcticDEM 2 m
fineRelief.attribution: ArcticDEM © Polar Geospatial Center, University of Minnesota

attribution.lakes: Freshwater Atlas © Province of British Columbia

bundle.description: Topo, imagery, LiDAR relief and contours, forest stands, water, roads, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Blanchard River; full detail within about 5 km of both spots.

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

topo.source: Toporama hypsography (contours and spot heights), NRCan WMS

satellite.source: Sentinel-2 L2A leaf-on median composite, 10 m, 12 scenes (Earth Search, AWS); no provincial imagery here
satellite.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data: free and open, credit required

hillshadeLidar.source: ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center
hillshadeLidar.licence: ArcticDEM: free, cite PGC (NSF OPP awards)
hillshadeLidar.note: ArcticDEM 2 m (with the MRDEM in its voids) over 100% of the core

dem.source: MRDEM 30 m, NRCan, with ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center over the core

contours.source: ArcticDEM 2 m mosaic v4.1 (a satellite-stereo surface model, voids filled from the MRDEM), Polar Geospatial Center
contours.licence: ArcticDEM: free, cite PGC (NSF OPP awards)

forest.source: Vegetation Resources Inventory (VRI) forest cover, Province of British Columbia, with later fire perimeters laid over

understory.source: Bush model (docs/BUSH-MODEL.md): the eye-level understory predicted at 30 m from Sentinel-2 seasons, PALSAR, SCANFI, CanLaD and the MRDEM, trained on 435 plots of Ontario leaf-on LiDAR; faded where the model is unsure. Modelled, not measured
understory.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

lanes.missing: no point-cloud adapter for BC yet (LidarBC where it has flown); the bush layer (understory) is the bush model's

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

bathySheets.missing: Ontario only: MNR lake survey sheets

places.source: BC Geographic Warehouse: wildlife management units, parks, private parcels and reserves, fire perimeters, roads and trails

wmu.source: Wildlife Management Units, Province of British Columbia

camps.missing: Ontario only: Crown land camps come from LIO

crown.source: ParcelMap BC parcels with a private, mixed, federal or municipal owner, and Indian reserves, Province of British Columbia

parks.source: Parks, conservancies, ecological reserves and protected areas (TANTALIS), Province of British Columbia

bathy.missing: Ontario only: lake bathymetry comes from LIO

fire.source: Fire perimeters, historical, BC Wildfire Service, Province of British Columbia

roads.source: Digital Road Atlas (every road, resource roads included) and TRIM trails, Province of British Columbia

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

depth.missing: Ontario only: lake depths need the ARA lake facts and the MNR sheets

waterbody.source: Freshwater Atlas lakes and rivers, Province of British Columbia

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads

treeline.from: the 98th percentile of the treed cells' elevation in the habitat grid; 31% of the land is above it, 98% of that open
